core_meaning.primary_meaning: Naqib corresponds to the Arabic form نَقِيب and is glossed in this record as “Leader, chief, captain.” The record associates the form with root ن ق ب (n-q-b). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Naqib corresponds to the Arabic form نَقِيب (Arabic root ن ق ب (n-q-b); نَقِيب (Naqīb)). Its core sense is naqib; leader, chief, captain. Naqib is Arabic نَقِيب (Naqīb) 'leader, chief, captain', from the root ن ق ب (n-q-b). The source gloss 'Leader, Administrator' is consistent. Same name as naqeeb.

persian.name: نقیب
